title: "Solar Detection & Income"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(tidycensus)
```

### Read in the data

```{r}
oahu_solar <- st_read(here("data/oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson"))

View(oahu_solar)
```

### Map the data

```{r}
mapview(oahu_solar)
```

Just for fun:

```{r}
ggplot(data = oahu_solar) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  theme_minimal() 
```

### Retrieve some census data

```{r}
oahu_median_household_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract", 
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "HI",
  county = "Honolulu",
  geometry = TRUE,
  year = 2022)
```

```{r}
mapview(oahu_median_household_income,
        zcol = "moe")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = oahu_median_household_income, 
       aes(x = moe, y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

```{r}
# Clean the solar data
oahu_solar_clean <- oahu_solar |>
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) |>   # drop the 68 empty geometries
  st_make_valid() |>                  # repair any self-intersecting polygons
  st_transform(26904)                 # NAD83 / UTM Zone 4N (meters)

# Clean the income data
oahu_income <- oahu_median_household_income |>
  st_transform(26904) |>
  select(GEOID, NAME,
         median_income = estimate,
         median_income_moe = moe)

# Confirm the two layers now share a CRS
st_crs(oahu_solar_clean) == st_crs(oahu_income)
```
